columns.benchmark_id: Stable row identifier unique within a benchmark dataset.
columns.source_type: surrogate_library, endogenous, literature_example, synthetic_smoke, web_manual, etc.
columns.editor: Exact base editor name when known, e.g. ABE8e, ABEmax, BE4.
columns.cell_context: Cell type, organism, delivery, or experimental context if known.
columns.delivery: plasmid, mRNA, AAV, LNP, unknown, etc.
columns.cas_variant: SpCas9, SpG, SpRY, NG, SaCas9, etc.
columns.sequence_context: Longest sequence supplied to or measured for the model.
columns.target_base: A, C, G, or T when the intended target base is specified.
columns.reference_outcome: Measured or intended edited sequence if available.
columns.measured_efficiency: Observed total editing efficiency, 0-1 when available.
columns.measured_outcome_frequency: Observed specific outcome frequency, 0-1 when available.
columns.split: train, validation, test, external_test, smoke, etc.
